storage.admission: ROOT refreshes global1TB reservations including active peers, own16GiB, separate fit/root allowances and other commitments; no double-counting. CPU/RSS/wall launch values require current host admission. No GPU is needed for generation/native observation creation.
storage.allocation_interpretation: Planning shares sum to12GiB; aggregate guard is authoritative. Native scratch is not measured by retained artifacts.
storage.heuristic: Three full200Mb retained generation+native totals are14.2to14.6GB. Linear10Mb projection is about0.71to0.73GB;12GiB operating allowance is approximately17times that projection. The original120GiB full-stage allowance scales to6GiB, also below12GiB. These are conservative planning comparisons, not measured short peak or runtime guarantees.

proportional_native_guard.before_stage: Require current live admission and execution-hold check, all writable paths inside charged scope, observed aggregate plus declared prospective Python write bound <=12GiB. Known serialized writes use byte estimates/actual sizes; preserve original tree2*nbytes+1MiB and native1GiB pre-step headroom checks.
proportional_native_guard.buffer: 4GiB remains reserved inside16GiB for unobserved growth during scan/detection/owned-family shutdown plus metadata. Do not spend this buffer on normal stage admission or a second parent.
proportional_native_guard.during_native: Dedicated own-family supervisor scans charged logical and allocated disk usage at most1second requested intervals, records actual scan times/maximum sample age and growth, checks finite RSS/wall budgets, and stops only its owned process family when measured total reaches12GiB or guard/admission fails. Use max(logical,allocated), reject symlink escape; include TMPDIR/work/tmp and captured stdout/stderr.
proportional_native_guard.failure: Fail the declared attempt and preserve its retained bytes/receipts. No shortening, partial scientific result, seed redraw, automatic retry or old-job cleanup.
proportional_native_guard.limitation: Periodic monitoring and a4GiB buffer do not mathematically guarantee every external native write stays under16GiB. Record this as a provisional finite operational attempt, monitor actual growth and stop early; no filesystem quota or mathematical hard-write proof is a blanket prerequisite.
proportional_native_guard.log_bound: Prospective log/receipt limits fit the256MiB metadata share; stop on overflow rather than silently truncate scientific evidence or allow uncharged logs.
proportional_native_guard.monitoring_liveness: Reviewable fail-closed handling for native monitor errors or stale samples; propose5second maximum sample age, measured against monotonic time. Preserve evidence and reap all owned children before concluding.

storage.scope: All development parents/attempts, generation truth+observed, native inputs/rawpre/post/chunks/temp/converted+cleaned copies, complete inference metadata, sampled registry, any later predictions/metrics, supervisor logs and manifests together.16GiB total, not per stage. Count existing failed evidence and no deletion assumptions.
